decisive_items: a multiloculated complex pelvic mass with thick septations
Serum CA-125 was elevated at 95 U/mL
response.rationale: The large complex multiloculated adnexal mass with thick septations and elevated CA-125 strongly favor ovarian cancer. Latent tuberculosis alone does not explain the imaging findings or mass size.

rejected.why: Latent tuberculosis is an incidental historical finding without active infection features, and the complex pelvic mass with elevated CA-125 is far more consistent with ovarian malignancy.
